answer_1.quote: We propose CSJ as a downstream task of text simplification and cross-lingual scientific summarization to generate a coherent cross-lingual popular science story.

answer_2.quote: We evaluate all models with three metrics: (1) ROUGE (Lin, 2004) -R1 and R2 compute the uni- and bi-gram overlaps ... (2) BERT-score (BS) ... (3) Flesch Kincaid Reading Ease (FRE) ...

answer_4.quote: We hired five annotators and provide them with 25 randomly selected outputs ... to evaluate each model summary ... for the following linguistic features ... Relevance ... Fluency ... Simplicity ... Overall Ranking.
answer_4.guideline: Annotators evaluated summaries on a 1-5 Likert scale for Relevance, Fluency, Simplicity, and Overall Ranking compared to reference summaries.
